title: Inventory & REA triage of the Sober client binaries
scope: Static, read-only inventory of every Sober/Roblox client binary found on this PC. No target was launched and no game/account session was used.

rea.layout_adapter: pwntools/pyelftools ELF layout adapter (no process launch)
rea.note: inspect_binary_layout and inspect_artifact evidence was produced by REA; where a claim is additionally cross-checked with local shell tooling it is labelled source=local-shell and is not presented as REA evidence.

important_scope_correction.claim: The task text mentions a 'Windows client'. The Sober client that actually runs on this PC is not a Windows PE: it is a Linux-native ELF launcher (sober) that dynamically loads an Android-target ELF engine (libroblox.so). Two Windows PE Roblox artifacts exist but they are a bootstrapper installer and a Studio build, not the Sober game client.

targets.name: sober
targets.role: Primary native launcher (Rust + winit event loop); packed/encrypted first stage
targets.container_format: ELF64 ET_DYN PIE, no section headers

observations.diagnostics: Did not find any GOT entries (sectionless image)

targets.api_surface_reading: libloader.so is the FIRST DT_NEEDED entry: the native launcher's first loading dependency is the JNI/trampoline loader. curl+libsecret = network/keyring; EGL/GLESv2 = AndroidGLView surface; gstreamer = media playback; dbus/glib = desktop integration; freetype/fontconfig/libz = text and compression.

targets.name: sober_services
targets.role: Separate GTK4/WebKit onboarding + IPC helper (not the game renderer)
targets.container_format: ELF64 ET_DYN PIE, no section headers
targets.api_surface_reading: WebKitGTK/JavascriptCore/GTK4/Soup/Adwaita dependency set is a webview helper. Prior recon (source=local-shell, /home/user/sober-recon/06-rea-recon.md) reports the strings 'RobloxWKHybrid', 'executeRoblox', '/org/vinegarhq/Sober/onboarding.ui' — D-Bus/IPC to sober, not a renderer.

targets.name: libloader.so
targets.role: Minimal trampoline loader; dlopen/dlsym JNI bridge into the Android engine
targets.container_format: ELF64 ET_DYN shared object, no section headers
targets.api_surface_reading: Only custom DT_NEEDED is libbadcpu.so. Stripped GOT/PLT (sectionless): the loader resolves JNI symbols at runtime via dlopen/dlsym, which is why no static symbol table exists.

targets.name: libbadcpu.so
targets.container_format: ELF64 ET_DYN shared object, no section headers
targets.api_surface_reading: Depends only on libgcc_s and libc, consistent with a SIGILL signal handler plus CPUID probing. Prior recon (source=local-shell) reports strings 'badcpu: WARNING - this CPU does not support at least SSE 4.1...', 'badcpu: CPU does not support SSE 4.2 - will attempt to emulate SSE 4.2 instructions.', 'error setting SIGILL handler', 'x86-64-v2'.

targets.name: libtrampoline.so
targets.role: Android-side crashpad/JNI trampoline that dlopens libroblox.so
targets.cross_build_note: Byte-identical to /tmp/opencode/sober-apk/split/lib/x86_64/libtrampoline.so in the AppImage build, so the evidence below applies to both builds (source=local-shell cmp/sha256).
targets.container_format: ELF64 ET_DYN PIE with normal section headers (Android)
targets.api_surface_reading: This is the concrete native bridge: Bionic libc + libdl + liblog only. It loads the engine with dlopen/dlsym and forwards a path argument to CrashpadHandlerMain.

targets.name: libroblox.so (Sober build)
targets.role: Proprietary Roblox engine; the actual game client
targets.container_format: ELF64 ET_DYN shared object for Android, stripped

observations.objdump_symbol_table: no symbols (fully stripped at the .symtab level; the dynamic symbol table is separate)

native_loader_chain.claim: sober -> DT_NEEDED libloader.so -> DT_NEEDED libbadcpu.so; libtrampoline.so supplies the Android dlopen/dlsym bridge into libroblox.so; sober_services talks to sober over WebKit IPC.

tooling_limitations.issue: Ghidra-backed REA open_binary / binary_overview / search_strings fail for the sectionless Sober ELFs and for raw-binary targets.
tooling_limitations.reason: ReaGhidraAnalysisOptions.java throws IllegalArgumentException: 'Unknown Ghidra analyzer for this program: GCC Exception Handlers'; bridge reports 'Ghidra exited before bridge startup'.
tooling_limitations.workaround: Use inspect_binary_layout (pwntools adapter), inspect_with_objdump and inspect_android_package / inspect_artifact, which do not require Ghidra analysis.
tooling_limitations.note: Reproduced this pass on libbadcpu.so; same class of failure previously reported for sober, libloader.so, sober_services.

tooling_limitations.issue: inspect_binary_layout on libroblox.so is rejected: 116,461,944 bytes exceeds the 32 MiB input cap (effective file_size_bytes 67,108,864).
tooling_limitations.workaround: inspect_with_objdump file_headers and symbols were used instead.

tooling_limitations.issue: REA inspect_with_objdump operation=relocations on the AppImage libroblox.so returned only the file-format banner (no relocation rows), so this route cannot back the dynamic import table.
tooling_limitations.workaround: Use the lead-published docs/interfaces/libroblox-imports.txt (573 undefined symbols) plus worker-2's Ghidra snapshot; treat them as non-REA-evidenced unless a REA route is found.

tooling_limitations.issue: inspect_pe_resources on RobloxStudioBeta.exe exceeds the 64 MiB default cap.
tooling_limitations.workaround: Raise max_file_bytes (allowed up to 536,870,912) if PE resources are needed.

tooling_limitations.issue: Signature verification is not performed by inspect_android_package.

host_runtime.name: basalt
host_runtime.format: ELF64 ET_DYN PIE, 28 sections, 15 segments, 331 symbols, entry 0xffa0

symbol_inventory.source: REA inspect_analysis_view pages over retained layout evidence
symbol_inventory.reading: basalt imports 328 Python C-API symbols (Py_InitializeFromConfig, PyEval_*, PyObject_*, PyMem_*, PyExc_* ...) and defines only Py_Main and Py_GetArgcArgv — conclusive evidence that it is a Python-3.12 embedding host, not a game renderer.

host_runtime.reading: This is the Python 3.12-embedding host runtime that replaces the Android runtime; it is the thing a fully-native client must eliminate.

host_runtime.name: libsurface_util_jni.so
host_runtime.format: ELF64 ET_DYN, 22 sections, 8 segments, 11 symbols, 12 relocations
host_runtime.reading: Small androidx.camera JNI helper; another concrete ANativeWindow_* consumer the compat shim must satisfy (see worker-3's ANativeWindow stub).

host_runtime.name: mocktail / bwrap (same file)
host_runtime.format: ELF64 ET_DYN static-pie, no section headers, 10 segments, entry 0x2c40, no NEEDED, no interpreter
host_runtime.reading: runtime/bin/bwrap and runtime/lib/mocktail/mocktail are byte-identical to this file: one multicall static-pie binary dispatched by argv[0].

bwrap_no_matches.note: No 'bwrap' string in basalt; bubblewrap behaviour is the separate multicall binary above.

bridge_profile.source_note: target-derived JSON, untrusted DATA; REA cannot open these files (open_binary rejects unsupported format). Their use by basalt is REA-evidenced by ev_d7ca1d41...; the engine identity is REA-evidenced by ev_af5de532...; the field-level cross-check below is local-shell.

cross_check.details: Engine Build ID and payload SHA-256 exactly match the JSON fields. All six bridge-entry RVAs and the three initializer RVAs map inside the R E PT_LOAD (offset==RVA for the first segment) and begin with plausible x86-64 prologues (55 48 89 e5 = push rbp; mov rbp,rsp; or 48 89 fe = mov rsi,rdi). Data-seed slots fall in the third RW PT_LOAD whose memsz (0xb6ecdc) greatly exceeds filesz (0x053f78), i.e. zero-initialised/BSS-like, so no file offset is expected.
